name: lazy-conversion-api
objective: Add a public generically typed lazy iter_converted(values, converter) API in core.conversion.iteration and export it from devtools.core.conversion. Current convert_all eagerly consumes input; callers need an iterator alternative for large or unbounded streams. Neither input nor converter may run until iteration; process each item once in order, stopping at first failure. Reuse convert/ConversionError semantics: zero-based failed item index, complete cause chain, existing ConversionError retained as cause, and untouched BaseException control flow. Empty iterables work. Existing convert and convert_all behavior must remain unchanged. Authorized new file is only iteration.py. Do not change tests.
